## Authorized scope

- Apply deterministic corrections directly, including stale status, activation, prerequisite, successor, completion, or acceptance prose whose operational owner is a chain or Task record; obsolete names and links; manual restatements that will be replaced by generated control-reference pages; historical material that is not clearly labeled historical; and naming that violates an accepted convention.

- Validate links, names, historical/current labeling, and the absence of documentation-only activation paths.
- Hand the remaining operational record families to harness.simplification.docs-json.schema-projection.
- Documentation may locate or explain work, but it cannot activate a Task or supply executable scope; do not invent a new execution-target resolver unless an actual executable path violates this rule and a separate Task authorizes that behavior.

## Completion criteria

- Corrected documentation and resolved links preserve subject-matter contracts and human intake, record an explicit unresolved list if any, and provide a bounded schema-projection handoff.

## Exclusions

- Do not create a human checkpoint for a deterministic correction governed by accepted authority.
